description: Defines the class 'ru_dummy_impl', a dummy radio unit implementation for performance and stability testing within the ocudu namespace. It includes member functions for handling downlink and uplink data, and manages internal components like sectors, metrics, and timing.

classes.name: ru_dummy_impl
classes.description: Implements a dummy radio unit for testing, managing sectors, timing, and data handling.

methods.name: get_controller
methods.description: Returns the controller interface of the radio unit.

methods.description: Returns the downlink plane handler interface.

methods.name: get_uplink_plane_handler
methods.description: Returns the uplink plane handler interface.

methods.name: get_metrics_collector
methods.description: Returns the metrics collector if metrics are enabled.

methods.name: get_center_frequency_controller
methods.description: Returns nullptr, indicating no center frequency control.

methods.description: Returns nullptr, indicating no gain control.

methods.description: Returns nullptr, indicating no CFO control.

methods.description: Returns nullptr, indicating no TX time offset control.
